zh-CN.title: 地图定位更准确
items: 位置地图会让头像始终贴合定位点，并围绕手指或鼠标位置缩放
带有地理信息的照片和视频现在可以从媒体详情直接打开地图
足迹与位置地图统一使用可旋转的地球仪，不再切换到平面地图

en.title: More precise map interactions
items: Location maps now keep avatars pinned correctly and zoom around your touch or pointer
Photos and videos with location data can now open the map directly from media details
Footprint and location maps now stay on the interactive globe instead of switching to a flat map
